q: Akta Petroleum (Langkah-Langkah Keselamatan) 1984 diwartakan pada:
e: Act 302 gazetted on 28th June 1984; Act A807 (Amendment) gazetted 12th September 1991.

q: Pindaan Akta A807 (1991) kepada Akta Petroleum bertujuan:
c: Memansuhkan peruntukan tidak perlu dan menambah peruntukan baharu
e: Act A807: repeals unnecessary provisions; addition of new provisions.

q: Bahagian V Akta Petroleum 1984 berkaitan dengan pengangkutan petroleum melalui:
e: Parts: II road & railway; III water; IV air; V pipelines; VI storage and handling.

q: Di bawah Akta Petroleum, 'handling' (pengendalian) termasuk:
c: Menyentuh, memegang, memindah atau menuang dengan tangan atau dengan bantuan
e: Handling: includes touching, feeling, grasping, transferring or decanting with the hand or assisted by any means.

q: Pemeriksa petroleum dilantik di bawah Seksyen:
e: Inspector: an inspector of petroleum appointed under Section 38.

q: Yang manakah termasuk hasil sampingan petroleum dalam Jadual Seksyen 2(1)?
e: Schedule: methane, ethane, propane, butane or hydrocarbons; gasoline; base oil; naphtha; lubricating oil; reformate; asphalt/bitumen; kerosene.

q: Di bawah Bahagian III Akta Petroleum, kapal yang membawa petroleum ke pelabuhan memerlukan:
c: Pemberitahuan kepada Pemeriksa dan kebenaran pegawai pelabuhan untuk memunggah
e: Part III: permitted loading/unloading, entry into port, notification to Inspector, permission of port officer to unload or discharge.

q: Semua kerja saluran paip petroleum (Bahagian V) memerlukan kelulusan:
e: Part V: approval of the Minister for all pipeline works (placing, inspection, maintenance, repair, upgrade).

q: Menyimpan dan mengendalikan petroleum tanpa lesen di bawah Bahagian VI adalah:
e: Part VI: prohibition to store and handle petroleum without license; Minister may formulate regulations for special conditions.

q: Akta Bekalan Gas 1993 diwartakan pada:
e: Gas Supply Act 1993 – Act 501 – gazetted on 4th February 1993.

q: Di bawah Akta Bekalan Gas, 'City Gate Station' ialah stesen yang:
c: Menerima gas terus dari saluran paip penghantaran dan mengatur tekanan sebelum diagihkan
w: Menjual tong gas kepada orang awam
e: City Gate station: gas measurement and pressure regulating where gas is received directly from transmission pipelines and delivered through distribution system.

q: Di bawah Akta Bekalan Gas, 'Orang Kompeten' ialah orang yang memegang:
c: Perakuan kekompetenan yang dikeluarkan oleh Suruhanjaya atau yang setara
e: Competent Person: holds a certificate of competency issued by the Commission or equivalent government certificate.

q: Pemegang lesen di bawah Akta Bekalan Gas mempunyai kuasa untuk:
c: Menentukan tarif dan memasuki tanah untuk pembinaan atau penyelenggaraan saluran paip
e: Provisions related to licence holders: determine tariffs, return of expenditure, deposit, inspect and enter land for pipeline construction/maintenance.

q: Di bawah Akta Bekalan Gas, kemalangan serius perlu dilaporkan oleh:
e: General: works by Competent Person; reporting of serious accidents by the user or license holder.

q: Akta Kualiti Alam Sekeliling 1974 diwartakan pada:
e: Environmental Quality Act 1974 – Act 127 – gazetted on 14 March 1974.

q: Bahagian III Akta Kualiti Alam Sekeliling 1974 berkaitan dengan:
e: Six parts: I Preliminary; II Administration; III Licences; IV Prohibition and Control of Pollution (IVA Scheduled Wastes); V Appeal; VI Miscellaneous.

q: Sekatan terhadap pencemaran bunyi diperuntukkan dalam Akta Kualiti Alam Sekeliling di bawah:
c: Bahagian IV – Larangan dan Kawalan Pencemaran
e: Part IV: prescribed premises licensed, plans approval, restriction on atmosphere, noise, soil, water pollution.

q: Akta Racun Makhluk Perosak 1974 (Akta 149) diwartakan pada:
e: Pesticides Act 1974 – Act 149 – gazetted on 29 August 1974; latest amendment 21 February 2017.

q: Bahagian II Akta Racun Makhluk Perosak 1974 berkaitan dengan:
e: Parts: I Preliminary; II The Pesticides Board; III registration & permit; IV licensing; V pesticides in food; … VII Enforcement; VIII Analysis.

q: Peruntukan 'Ruang terbuka tidak boleh diubah atau diberi bumbung' terdapat dalam UBBL 1984 di bawah:
c: Bahagian III – Ruang, Cahaya dan Pengudaraan
e: Part III Space, light and ventilation: open spaces to be provided; not to be altered or roofed; space about buildings abutting street and backlane.
